title: Accuracy Gate & Calibration Orchestrator for FP8/INT8 Profiles
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an automated evaluation and calibration orchestrator that establishes an "accuracy gate" for FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles. The orchestrator will run calibration sweeps, produce a standardized set of quality metrics (perplexity, MMLU-style classification suites, Rouge/BLEU for generation tasks, task-specific scorers like F1/EM/AUC), and make pass/fail decisions tied to rollout policies. Outputs will feed the model catalog (profile metadata) and the console rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration runs produce deterministic quant scales and a calibration artifact stored in model catalog
Accuracy gate evaluates against FP16 baseline and outputs pass/fail with numeric deltas
Suite of metrics implemented: perplexity, MMLU-style aggregated accuracy, Rouge-L, BLEU, exact match (EM), F1, and task-specific scorers where applicable
Orchestrator supports per-tensor and per-channel INT8 modes and experimental FP8 mode, and tags profile with mode and observed metrics
Rollout policies can automatically block model promotion if MMLU accuracy drops >2% absolute or BLEU drops >1.5 points vs baseline (configurable)
End-to-end run finishes reproducibly within target budget for a 7B-class model (calibration + metrics run < 3 hours on standard CI runners with reserved GPUs)
design_decisions: Use FP16/FP32 run as golden baseline rather than older 16-bit baselines to avoid historical drift
Calibration will support percentile clipping (0.999), KL-divergence minimization, and MSE minimization options — default to 99.9th percentile then KL for distribution-sensitive layers
Collect activation statistics with per-layer and per-channel hooks; store a compact calibration artifact (JSON + per-layer tensors in compressed .npz) in model catalog
Metric suite will compute both aggregated and per-subset scores (short, medium, long sequences; high/low rare-token density) to surface distributional regressions
Implement evaluation isolation: KV-cache warmup runs must mirror serving path (streaming vs non-streaming) to avoid quantization-induced cache mismatch
Calibration sweep orchestrator will run in parallel across GPU workers but gather deterministic random seeds for reproducibility
technical_notes: Calibration dataset: sample up to 2,048 examples stratified across seq length buckets (<=128, 129-512, >512) drawn from held-out validation sets — tokenization must match service tokenization map
Per-layer quant granularity: prefer per-channel for linear weight matrices, per-tensor for small layers to reduce overhead
FP8 path currently experimental; map FP8 variants to two shared exponent formats supported by runtime and annotate profiles accordingly

Metrics implementations: perplexity computed on full-token logprob sum normalized by token count; MMLU-style suite uses majority-answer aggregation and macro/micro breakdowns; Rouge and BLEU use detokenized text with standard smoothing for short outputs
Task-specific scorers: QA uses SQuAD EM/F1 logic; classification supports macro-F1 and AUC; summarization uses ROUGE-L and BERTScore (optional heavy scorer)
Statistical significance: when delta is near threshold, run bootstrap sampling (n=1000) to compute 95% confidence interval
CI integration: expose a single "quant-eval" entrypoint that accepts model artifact, profile config, and calibration dataset name and emits metrics JSON and pass/fail status
progress_updates: 2026-02-20: Spike completed comparing percentile clipping vs KL for per-channel calibration on LLaMA-2-7B; KL reduced tail-outliers in attention outputs by 12%

2026-02-28: Integrated perplexity and Rouge-L scorers into metrics core; added detokenization sanity checks to avoid tokenization mismatch errors

2026-03-04: Ran end-to-end pipeline for quant profile 'int8-fast-1' on two models; observed MMLU drop of 1.8% vs FP16 baseline and BLEU drop of 0.9 on translation suite — within provisional thresholds
2026-03-08: Discovered edge-case where streaming-enabled evaluation produced different logits due to KV cache ordering. Added KV warmup path to mimic streaming and reran tests — results stabilized
2026-03-10: Drafted rollout policy thresholds and config schema; opened PR for metrics JSON schema and orchestration CLI
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Calibration dataset may not represent downstream customer distributions -> Mitigation: support custom calibration sets and per-customer re-calibration on Dedicated/Private deployments
Risk: FP8 behaviors vary across hardware drivers -> Mitigation: mark FP8 profiles experimental and include hardware-target tag; require manual signoff for production promotion
Risk: Heavy scorers (BERTScore) increase CI cost -> Mitigation: make heavy scorers optional behind feature flag and run them on a schedule rather than every commit
Risk: Non-determinism across GPU drivers -> Mitigation: pin CUDA/cuDNN versions in CI and record seeds and environment in calibration artifact metadata
